newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Zhuzhou Torch '96 profits slide.
newsitem.headline: China's Zhuzhou Torch '96 profits slide.

text.p: Automobile components maker Zhuzhou Torch Spark Plug Co Ltd said on Friday its net profit plunged 80 percent to 1.65 million yuan in 1996 from 8.08 million yuan in 1995.

The fall was sparked by the company's moves to curb rises in its accounts receivable, cuts in the price of its products and by price rises for raw materials and fuel, Zhuzhou Torch said in its annual report, published in Friday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times.

Turnover fell 34.12 percent to 72.64 million yuan from 110.26 million yuan in 1995 due in part to the firm's efforts to counter ballooning accounts receivable by reducing goods supply to customers with poor credit records.
Accounts receivable stood at 74.79 million yuan at the end of 1996, down from 85.33 million yuan at the beginning of last year, it said.

The company statement said it cut the sale price of products in order to maintain market share, a move that cost 2.1 million yuan. It said higher prices for raw materials and fuel cut a further 980,000 yuan from profits.
The firm does not plan to issue a dividend for 1996, it said, adding the plan needed approval from shareholders at a forthcoming meeting.
The company's 1996 per share net was 0.017 yuan, down 79.52 percent from 0.083 yuan in 1995.
Analysts said the company is suffering from a shortage of working capital, given its current assets of 150.66 million yuan at the end of last year, against current liabilities of 125.56 million yuan.
